endpoints.description: Scrape any public web page and get clean structured JSON (title, text, meta). Pay per call with USDC on Base.
Classifies captcha type (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile) and difficulty. Eval only — we do NOT solve captchas.
Block height + chain stats for Base or Ethereum.
Live-checks a domain: is it up, does it have TLS, what's the title? Quick domain health check for agents evaluating links.
ENS name resolution + reverse lookup via public Ethereum RPC.
Extracts named entities (people, companies, places) from text. Wikidata resolution next iteration.
Geocode + timezone + currency context for any location string.
Entailment scoring: does the provided context support this claim? Research agents use this to self-check outputs.
Generates 1 PNG from a text prompt (FLUX.1-dev, 512px). Async: returns job ID + poll URL. GPU-backed via RunPod ComfyUI, scale-to-zero.
Validates JSON, detects PII inside values, reports schema stats. Pipeline agents use this as a data-quality gate.
Coerces messy text (key=value lines, CSV-ish, sentences) into clean JSON.
Extracts all outbound links from a page, classified by domain. Shows where a page links to and which domains dominate.
Current transaction nonce for any address on Base or Ethereum. Agent tx bots need this before sending transactions.
Extracts OG tags, canonical URL, title, and meta description from any web page. Useful for link previews, SEO audits, and content enrichment.
Detects PII (emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards) in any text with character spans. Compliance agents use this before processing user data.
Scrapes any public web page and returns clean structured JSON (title, text, length). The workhorse — agents use this for real data extraction.
Checks if a URL supports a claim. Returns confidence score. Research agents use this to verify sources.
Sentiment classification (positive/negative/neutral) + emotion keyword hits.
Finds similar/competitor domains by name-similarity. Lead-gen agents use this for prospecting.
Extractive summary (3 sentences) + top-5 keywords from any text.
Token security heuristics: honeypot signals, proxy detection, LP data. Trading agents use this to avoid rugs.
Scores prompt-injection / jailbreak risk for LLM inputs. Agent builders use this to sanitize user inputs before hitting their LLM.
Palette contrast matrix (WCAG AA/AAA) + nearest passing color suggestions. Offline.
